notes.title: Discord: OPEN!🎉
notes.content:
《KEEPERS of the KEEP》Discord: Open!🎉
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494370/ab1f403d58f8ec4aa42471b1a9ac3408424d049e.png"]

Hey y'all!



I wanted to let y'all know that KINJAKO has an official discord now! Because this is a KINJAKO discord, this means that you can join the server to not only talk about Keepers of the Keep, but also GESTALT and any future projects that we plan to work on! 



In this discord, you'll be able to do anything from catching updates and posts from the studio, give feedback and report bugs, post fanart and memes, and give suggestions on future updates to Keepers of the Keep! This is also a place where you'll be able to hang with other fans of the game, talk among one another, and show off your own art and projects.



If that sounds like your thing, consider joining today! A link to the discord will be offered below, and can be found on the store pages for all KINJAKO games as well. If you played the Keepers of the Keep demo or GESTALT: The Fifth Day, join up and tell a friend!

notes.title: The Steam Next Fest is HERE!✨
notes.content:
《KEEPERS of the KEEP》The Steam Next Fest is HERE!


Hey y'all!



The Steam Next Fest begins today! For those of you that don't know, the Next Fest is a celebration of upcoming games, where you download a buncha demos and play them all before they're out! And, for those of you playing along, Keepers of the Keep is also an upcoming game with a demo that's out right now! We've signed up with the Next Fest, and we're really hoping to show off the game to a lot of new faces, especially while the Kickstarter campaign is still going on right now!



If you're a streamer or Youtuber and you decide to play Keepers of the Keep as part of your demo lineup, feel free to give us a shoutout on social media (links below), and we'll make sure you get boosted! This is an incredibly exciting event for us, so please feel free to reach out, tag us, shout us out, post in the discussion, or whatever else you wanna do to let us know how you're liking the game!



Have a good Next Fest everyone, we hope you like the demo!



- KINJA

notes.title: Keepers of the Keep: DEMO OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
《KEEPERS of the KEEP》
DEMO RELEASES TODAY!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494370/8e381e22bcfa7dab9e65d95e31b4a079c6798632.png

Hey y'all!

For those of you who have been curious about Keepers of the Keep, I'm so happy to announce that the game's demo is now available for everyone to play!🎉✨ Play through 6 quests, manage your stats, work your day job, and much more! 

The demo will receive regular updates to fix any errors that may occur along the way, and may even pick up some new features as the full game is being developed. So, if you want to get familiar with Keepers of the Keep and how the game works, now is the time to start practicing your dice rolls! Happy demo launch day, y'all!
